entries.food: Oikos Triple Zero Non Fat Greek Yogurt
entries.source_note: PDF states serving as '1, 5.3oz container' with per-serving macros kcal 120, fat 0, carb 15, protein 15. Converted 5.3 oz -> 150.25 g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz, then scaled to per-100g. Assumes the '5.3oz' is a net-weight ounce (standard for a semi-solid dairy cup label), not a fluid ounce.

PDF: 0.5 tablespoon, kcal 47, fat 4.05, carb 1.55, protein 2. Gram weight (16.0 g/tbsp) from USDA FDC id 174266 'Peanut butter, smooth style, with salt' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 2.0, modifier: 'tbsp', gramWeight: 32.0} -> 32.0/2.0 = 16.0 g/tbsp. Macros are the PDF's own, NOT USDA's. 0.5 tbsp = 8.0 g; scaled to per-100g.
PDF: 1 ounce, kcal 116, fat 7.3, carb 3.1, protein 9.4. Converted to per-100g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz.
PDF: 2 ounce, kcal 318, fat 20, carb 0, protein 32. Converted to per-100g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz.
PDF: 6 oz, kcal 279, fat 6, carb 0, protein 52.8. Converted to per-100g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz.

PDF: '(1/4 cup) red onion, chopped', qty 0.25 cup, kcal 16.75, fat 0, carb 4, protein 0.375. Gram weight (160.0 g/cup) from USDA FDC id 170000 'Onions, raw' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 1.0, modifier: 'cup, chopped', gramWeight: 160.0}. This is a generic (not red-specific) onion entry -- FDC has no 'Onions, red, raw' entry with a cup portion; the Foundation red-onion entry (fdcId 790577) only has 'Onion' (197g) and 'RACC' (85g) portions, no cup. Macros are the PDF's own. 0.25 cup = 40.0 g; scaled to per-100g.

PDF: '(trader joes) (1/3 cup) great northern beans canned', qty 0.33 cup, kcal 66, fat 0, carb 12.54, protein 4.62. Gram weight (262.0 g/cup) from USDA FDC id 175192 'Beans, great northern, mature seeds, canned' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 1.0, modifier: 'cup', gramWeight: 262.0}. Macros are the PDF's own. 0.33 cup = 86.46 g; scaled to per-100g.

PDF: '(1 tsp) Extra Virgin Olive Oil', qty 0.33 tbsp, kcal 39.6, fat 4.62, carb 0, protein 0 (note the row's parenthetical annotation says '1 tsp' but the Measurement column says 'tbsp' at qty 0.33, which is internally consistent since 0.33 tbsp is approx 1 tsp). Gram weight (13.5 g/tbsp) from USDA FDC id 171413 'Oil, olive, salad or cooking' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 1.0, modifier: 'tablespoon', gramWeight: 13.5}. No SR Legacy 'extra virgin' specific entry has a household tbsp portion; the Foundation 'extra virgin' entry (fdcId 748608) only reports a 100 mL -> 90.7 g density, no direct tbsp figure, so the generic olive-oil SR Legacy tbsp weight was used instead as the closest entry with an actual stated portion. Macros are the PDF's own. 0.33 tbsp = 4.455 g; scaled to per-100g.

PDF: 3 wedge, kcal 3, fat 0, carb 1.5, protein 0.3. Gram weight (7.0 g/wedge) from USDA FDC id 167746 'Lemons, raw, without peel' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 1.0, modifier: 'wedge or slice (1/8 of one 2-1/8" dia lemon)', gramWeight: 7.0}. Macros are the PDF's own. 3 wedge = 21.0 g; scaled to per-100g.
PDF: 4 ounces, kcal 292, fat 17.2, carb 0, protein 31.6. Converted to per-100g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz.
PDF row labeled '(measured dry)': 1.5 oz, kcal 142.5, fat 2.25, carb 22.5, protein 8.25. Converted to per-100g using standard 28.349523125 g/oz. Value is per dry weight, not cooked weight.

PDF: 0.5 cup, kcal 64.5, fat 1.95, carb 9.95, protein 1.85. Gram weight from USDA FDC id 171192 'Sauce, pasta, spaghetti/marinara, ready-to-serve' (SR Legacy), foodPortions entry {amount: 1.0, modifier: 'serving 1/2 cup', gramWeight: 132.0} -> 132.0 g per half-cup, so 264.0 g/cup. (Foundation fdcId 332282 has the same description but 404s on the food-detail endpoint, so the SR Legacy entry was used instead.) Macros are the PDF's own. 0.5 cup = 132.0 g -- matches USDA's own half-cup weight exactly; scaled to per-100g.
